f1de28cc5915.zh:
從攤平的大笨蛋
到雪花還原的生成流形
f1de28cc5915.en:
From the Big Dummy That Flattens
to the Generative Manifold That Restores Snowflakes

04e718d05e91.zh: 1980 別攤平 → 冬眠 → 2006 逐層喚醒 → 2012 全明星 → 生成對抗與擴散 Don’t flatten → winter → layer-wise awakening → all-star → GAN & Diffusion.
04e718d05e91.en: 1980 don’t flatten → winter → 2006 layer-by-layer awakening → 2012 all-stars → adversarial generation and diffusion

afc490816a6e.zh: ▾ SCROLL TO EXPLORE · 長頁自學模式
afc490816a6e.en: ▾ SCROLL TO EXPLORE · Long-Page Self-Study Mode

0bd41bb1bb43.zh:
為何要「攤平」會毀掉一張圖？
又為何一片雪花能變回名畫？Why does flattening destroy an image? How can snow become a masterpiece?
0bd41bb1bb43.en:
Why does “flattening” ruin an image?
And why can a flurry of snow turn back into a masterpiece?

41f52207441e.zh: 前者在幾何，後者在機率——CNN 守住二維，擴散學會逆向去噪。Former is geometry, latter is probability — CNN keeps 2D, diffusion learns denoising.
41f52207441e.en: The first is about geometry, the second about probability: CNNs preserve the 2D structure, and diffusion learns to reverse the noise (denoising).

56880672fd4e.zh: 四站時光機 Four Stops — Flatten → Winter → Revival → Generation

7a7ea398be20.zh: 攤平破壞結構 → 冬眠（梯度消失+無算力）→ 逐層無監督喚醒 → 全明星引爆 → 生成學會畫畫。Flatten breaks → winter (vanishing+no compute) → layer-wise awakening → all-star → generative painting.
7a7ea398be20.en: Flattening destroys structure → winter (vanishing gradients + no compute) → layer-by-layer unsupervised awakening → the all-stars ignite it → generative models learn to paint.

17fc0dec8d82.zh: 局部連結 + 權重共享，保二維、平移不變、參數銳減。Local + sharing → keep 2D, translation invariant.
17fc0dec8d82.en: Local connectivity + weight sharing: keeps the 2D structure, gives translation invariance, and slashes the parameter count.

fd617708095e.zh: 梯度消失 + 無算力資料；SVM 以高維映射一刀切成主流。Vanishing + no data; SVM cuts in high-D.
fd617708095e.en: Vanishing gradients + no compute or data; SVMs, which separate the classes with one clean cut after a high-dimensional mapping, become the mainstream.

1ad547b59792.zh: 逐層預訓練解凍深層；ReLU + GPU + Dropout 引爆。Layer-wise thaws deep; ReLU+GPU+Dropout explodes.
1ad547b59792.en: Layer-wise pretraining thaws deep networks; ReLU + GPU + Dropout set off the explosion.

31f2987ef421.zh: GAN 對抗互傷害；擴散 加噪→去噪，雪花還原。GAN adversarial; Diffusion snow→restore.
31f2987ef421.en: GANs: two networks fighting and hurting each other; diffusion: add noise → remove noise, turning snow back into the picture.

86342d8dcebd.zh: 直覺 · 拼圖與放大鏡
86342d8dcebd.en: Intuition · Jigsaw Puzzle and Magnifying Glass

eb5a851e7149.zh: 攤平是把拼圖倒成一排；卷積是拿同一放大鏡掃全圖找螞蟻。Flatten = dump puzzle in a line; convolution = same magnifier scans for ants.
eb5a851e7149.en: Flattening is pouring a jigsaw puzzle out into a single line; convolution is sweeping the same magnifying glass over the whole picture looking for ants.

a53fc3cbc891.zh: 1 · CNN 誕生：別把影像攤平成大笨蛋 CNN — Don’t Flatten, Convolve
a53fc3cbc891.en: 1 · The Birth of CNN: Don’t Be the Big Dummy That Flattens the Image

3aae12d1de22.zh: Neocognitron（福島 1980）提出兩大神功，LeCun 以 Backprop 於 1989 實作為 LeNet-5 認手寫支票。Neocognitron two tricks → LeNet-5 with Backprop reads checks.
3aae12d1de22.en: The Neocognitron (Fukushima, 1980) introduced two great tricks; in 1989 LeCun implemented them with backprop as LeNet-5, which read handwritten checks.

b87792f983be.en: One filter scans the whole image

3d9f444ba2ae.zh: 平移不變性：同一放大鏡找螞蟻
3d9f444ba2ae.en: Translation invariance: one magnifier finds the ants

a55ee878277d.zh: LeNet-5 (1989): Backprop + 卷積 = 認手寫支票
a55ee878277d.en: LeNet-5 (1989): backprop + convolution = reads handwritten checks

a9719804f95c.zh: 局部看小窗、同一濾鏡掃全圖 → 保二維、平移不變、參數銳減 · Local + sharing → keep 2D & invariant.
a9719804f95c.en: Look through a small local window, scan the whole image with the same filter → keeps the 2D structure, translation invariant, far fewer parameters.

27d1e1b4a69f.zh: 為何別攤平 Why Not Flatten

6ba74f208ebe.zh: 「8」上下圈在二維相鄰，攤平後隔 4900 位——空間結構被摧毀。Adjacent in 2D, far in 1D — structure destroyed.
6ba74f208ebe.en: The top and bottom loops of an “8” are neighbors in 2D, but after flattening they are 4900 positions apart: the spatial structure is destroyed.

beeedd01fb19.zh: 拿同一放大鏡掃全圖找螞蟻，無論左上或右下皆可——權重共享即平移不變。Same magnifier scans for ants — sharing = invariance.
beeedd01fb19.en: Sweep the same magnifying glass over the whole picture to look for ants, and it works whether they are top-left or bottom-right: weight sharing is translation invariance.

a8a58abb974e.zh: 為後世 CNN（AlexNet→ResNet→Vision Transformer 的對手）奠定兩大公理。Two axioms for all later CNNs.
a8a58abb974e.en: Laid down the two axioms for every later CNN (AlexNet → ResNet → the rivals of the Vision Transformer).

c6c91a4a69c0.zh: 濾鏡 $W$（如 $2\times2$ 橫線檢測 $[ -1 -1 ; 1 1 ]$）在 $X$ 上滑動，對應相乘再求和即特徵圖。Slide $W$ over $X$, multiply-sum → feature map.
c6c91a4a69c0.en: A filter $W$ (e.g. a $2\times2$ horizontal-line detector $[ -1 -1 ; 1 1 ]$) slides over $X$; multiplying the overlapping entries and summing gives the feature map.

47a378402f29.zh: 卷積怎麼算：橫線檢測 $4\times4 \to 3\times3$ Convolution in Numbers
47a378402f29.en: How convolution is computed: horizontal-line detection, $4\times4 \to 3\times3$

48a0cf60f658.zh: 輸入 $X$（$4\times4$ 橫線）與濾鏡 $W$（$2\times2$ 橫線檢測）在 $(0,0)$ 得 $0$、$(1,0)$ 得 $2$ 高分。Input $X$ vs filter $W$: (0,0)=0 blank, (1,0)=2 hit.
48a0cf60f658.en: With input $X$ (a $4\times4$ horizontal line) and filter $W$ (a $2\times2$ horizontal-line detector), position $(0,0)$ gives $0$ and $(1,0)$ gives a high score of $2$.

6e8b8e85588c.zh: matplotlib 精準：攤平破結構 vs 滑動保幾何 vs 特徵圖 Precise convolution
6e8b8e85588c.en: Precise matplotlib view: flattening breaks the structure vs. sliding preserves the geometry vs. the feature map

eb58cf991fec.zh: 左 16 維攤平破結構；中同一 $2\times2$ 濾鏡掃描 $(0,0)=0$ vs $(1,0)=2$；右 $3\times3$ 特徵圖高分即橫線 · Flatten breaks; sliding preserves; map highlights line.
eb58cf991fec.en: Left: flattening to 16 dimensions breaks the structure; middle: the same $2\times2$ filter scans $(0,0)=0$ vs. $(1,0)=2$; right: in the $3\times3$ feature map, the high scores are the horizontal line.

d5ddf60fadfd.zh:
$(0,0)$：$0\cdot-1+0\cdot-1+0\cdot1+0\cdot1=0$（空白）
$(1,0)$：$0\cdot-1+0\cdot-1+1\cdot1+1\cdot1=2$（命中）
$(1,1)$ 同 $2$，特徵圖對應高亮。Blank 0, hit 2 — map lights up.
d5ddf60fadfd.en:
$(0,0)$: $0\cdot-1+0\cdot-1+0\cdot1+0\cdot1=0$ (blank)
$(1,0)$: $0\cdot-1+0\cdot-1+1\cdot1+1\cdot1=2$ (hit)
$(1,1)$ also gives $2$, and the corresponding cells of the feature map light up.

fbbd96ce6375.zh: 局部連結保幾何、權重共享減參數且平移不變——CNN 兩大公理。Local keeps geometry; sharing cuts params & gives invariance.
fbbd96ce6375.en: Local connectivity preserves geometry; weight sharing cuts parameters and gives translation invariance. These are the two axioms of CNNs.

9b22692fac97.zh: 互動：拉動閾值看特徵圖二值化 Threshold the map
9b22692fac97.en: Interactive: drag the threshold to binarize the feature map

ebb90ef253fb.zh: 2 · 冬眠與 SVM 興起（1980s–2006） Winter & SVM Rise
ebb90ef253fb.en: 2 · The winter and the rise of SVMs (1980s–2006)

0b49d242bd04.zh: 深層學不進去（梯度消失）、沒算力資料；SVM 以高維映射一刀切成主流。Deep won’t learn (vanishing), no compute; SVM cuts in high-D.
0b49d242bd04.en: Deep networks wouldn't learn (vanishing gradients), and there was neither the compute nor the data; SVMs became the mainstream by mapping to high dimensions and splitting the data with a single cut.

b816183afa8e.zh: 輸出誤差 → 回傳衰減→ 前層學不動
b816183afa8e.en: Output error → decays on the way back → early layers can't learn

12db3baad3c3.en: Deep layers · signal goes to zero

005fa4ff0e31.zh: SVM：二維切不開→高維一刀切
005fa4ff0e31.en: SVM: can't split in 2D → one cut in high-D

85b92e072ca0.zh: 核映射至無限維、數學穩固
85b92e072ca0.en: Kernel maps to infinite dims, solid math

3e073634af68.zh: 神經網路冷宮·核方法主流
3e073634af68.en: Neural nets in the doghouse · kernel methods reign

111be37e4103.zh: 深層梯度歸零，前層凍結；SVM 高維一刀切 · Deep gradients vanish; SVM cuts in high-D.
111be37e4103.en: In deep networks the gradient goes to zero and the early layers freeze; SVMs split the data with a single cut in high dimensions.

d71d1809e53a.zh: 反向傳播深層時誤差信號衰減至歸零，前層欸歸不動。Error signal decays to zero in deep layers.
d71d1809e53a.en: In backpropagation through deep networks, the error signal decays to zero, so the early layers can't learn.

907796ac49e5.zh: CPU 慢如龜、資料少，大型網路不現實。Slow CPU, tiny data — large nets impossible.
907796ac49e5.en: CPUs were as slow as turtles and data was scarce, so large networks weren't realistic.

af1cc4e91fc2.zh: 「切不開就升維」——隱式映射至超高維，再複雜的結也一刀切。If not separable, lift to high-D and cut.
af1cc4e91fc2.en: “If you can't split it, lift it to a higher dimension”: an implicit mapping to a very high-dimensional space, where even the most tangled knot is cut with a single stroke.

641ddf54db96.zh: 3 · 2006 復興：一層一層學 2006 Revival — Layer-wise Pretraining
641ddf54db96.en: 3 · The 2006 revival: learning one layer at a time

ac3345194683.zh: Hinton & Salakhutdinov 以 DBN 無監督逐層預訓練打破冰河：先感受資料長相，再微調。DBN layer-wise unsupervised pretraining broke winter: feel data, then fine-tune.
ac3345194683.en: Hinton & Salakhutdinov broke the ice age with unsupervised layer-wise pretraining of DBNs: first get a feel for what the data looks like, then fine-tune.

351ebb9dcaf5.zh: 一層一層先感受，再反向傳播微調——緩解梯度消失
351ebb9dcaf5.en: Get a feel one layer at a time, then fine-tune with backpropagation: eases vanishing gradients

861f39488f28.zh: 單層先感受資料，再整體微調——紂凍· Layer-wise feel, then tune — thaw.
861f39488f28.en: Each single layer first gets a feel for the data, then the whole network is fine-tuned: the thaw.

8d2db5b39a08.zh: $$單層 RBM 逐層無監督預訓練 \to \text{Backprop 微調}$$

7aa56b3ae102.zh: 每層先學 p(資料)，初始化好後再用監督信號整體優化，梯度不再歸零。Each layer learns p(data) first; then supervised fine-tuning — gradients survive.
7aa56b3ae102.en: Each layer first learns p(data); once the network is well initialized, the supervised signal optimizes it as a whole, and the gradients no longer go to zero.

5e5c94b4b400.zh: 4 · AlexNet 2012：點燃全明星週末 AlexNet — All-Star Weekend
5e5c94b4b400.en: 4 · AlexNet 2012: kicking off the all-star weekend

77cfb6e1035a.zh: 集 ReLU、GPU、Dropout 三大武功於一身，在 ImageNet 樫空出世。ReLU + GPU + Dropout together on ImageNet.
77cfb6e1035a.en: Combining the three signature moves ReLU, GPU and Dropout in one, it burst onto the scene at ImageNet.

817491ff826e.zh: 正數直輸、負數歸零；計算快、梯度永不消失。Fast, gradient never vanishes.
817491ff826e.en: Positive values pass straight through, negative values become zero; fast to compute, and the gradient never vanishes.

8b94140621f4.zh: 放棄 CPU、用 GPU 並行，訓練從週縮至天。From weeks to days.
8b94140621f4.en: Dropping the CPU for parallel GPUs cut training time from weeks to days.

b9dfdefdc38c.zh: 隨機關掉部分神經元，強迫剩余學更穩健特徵。Random off → robust features.
b9dfdefdc38c.en: Randomly switch off some of the neurons, forcing the rest to learn more robust features.

4a7012a698cf.zh: 大幅超越傳統方法，點燃深度學習熱潮。Huge margin, ignites deep learning.
4a7012a698cf.en: It beat traditional methods by a wide margin and ignited the deep learning boom.

0b7c62fb8206.zh: 互動：ReLU vs Sigmoid 梯度對比 Gradient comparison
0b7c62fb8206.en: Interactive: ReLU vs. sigmoid gradient comparison

e72034ccc44a.zh: 5 · 生成形模：GAN 對抗 vs 擴散需花 Generative — GAN vs Diffusion
e72034ccc44a.en: 5 · Generative models: GAN's adversarial game vs. diffusion's snow

8e6d084bc0c4.zh: GAN 讓兩神經互相傷害；擴散「加噪再去噪」，雪花還原。GAN makes two nets hurt each other; Diffusion adds then removes snow.
8e6d084bc0c4.en: GANs make two neural networks hurt each other; diffusion “adds noise, then removes it” and restores the image from snow.

b7f2c6e8e7cd.zh: 生成器畫假畫騙判別器，判別器拆穿假畫——對抗到分不出真假。Generator fools, Discriminator exposes.
b7f2c6e8e7cd.en: The generator paints fakes to fool the discriminator, and the discriminator exposes the fakes, until the two fight to the point where real and fake can't be told apart.

2e1dd2730097.zh: 品質高，但訓練不穩、模式崩潰 (high quality, unstable)
2e1dd2730097.en: High quality, but unstable training and mode collapse

dd8e0c9de243.zh: 核心公式對抗損失 (adversarial loss)
dd8e0c9de243.en: The core formula is the adversarial loss

4660d9f1d197.zh: 訓練時逐步加雪花至純噪聲；教網路逐步去雪花還原。Add snow to pure noise; learn to denoise step by step.
4660d9f1d197.en: During training, snow is added step by step until only pure noise remains; the network is taught to remove the snow step by step and restore the image.

d85d1b451ae7.zh: 訓練穩、品質極高，Midjourney/SD 背後 (stable, SOTA)
d85d1b451ae7.en: Stable training, extremely high quality; it powers Midjourney/SD

7736c40ba494.zh: 核心「需花還原術」 (snow restoration)
7736c40ba494.en: The core is the “snow restoration trick”

1f1929b1bc14.zh: 逆向學 $p_\theta(x_{t-1}|x_t)$ 去噪。Learn reverse denoising.

cdaf9f504abf.zh: 假畫騙真 vs 拆穿·對抗到分不出
cdaf9f504abf.en: Fakes to fool vs. exposing · fight until indistinguishable

adf2dab8fc8f.zh: 逆向去噪學生成·給雪花變名畫
adf2dab8fc8f.en: Learn to generate by reverse denoising · snow into a masterpiece

38e6029d5503.zh: 左對抗互傷害；右加噪至雪花再逆向去噪生成 · Adversarial vs snow-to-masterpiece.
38e6029d5503.en: Left: the two networks hurt each other adversarially; right: add noise until it's snow, then generate by reverse denoising.

bc023e845f4b.en: The Full Timeline of the Evolution

2a82dd20260a.en: Fukushima proposes local connectivity + weight sharing, preserving the 2D structure.

89e56c193ee9.en: Combining convolution with backpropagation, it became the ancestor of CNNs.

c35fd278a65e.en: Deep networks are hard to train; SVMs, with kernels that cut cleanly in one stroke, take over the mainstream.
